name: story-score
title: Show a score at the end of a story
issue: Issue #55. If stories have no graded questions to score, stop with needsUser.
acceptance: Story end shows correct/total and percentage
Page-turn reveal, none under reduced motion
lint, tsc -b, build, test green locally and in CI
